{{Top|leg}}
The '''TX-100 weapon power magazine component''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] magazine component produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The TX-100 boosted a starship's maximum weapon power, something that was popular with starships that had power-heavy arsenals.
